title: Migrate proof retention to per-kind days
body:
### Summary

As a quality architect, I want retention_days migrated to a retention per artifact kind, so that existing configs keep their meaning.

### Completion Goal

1. [api-trace] state: a config with `[proof] retention_days = 90`; expected: `aayu config show` reports 90 days for every kind after the migration
2. [api-trace] state: `aayu upgrade` on that config, then its rollback; expected: the file is restored byte for byte

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

all 2 criteria

### Scenario

Load a v1 config, run the migration, show the config, then roll the migration back.

### Environment

local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production
